_doc: The snow over the land (user 2026-09-28: 'we need to make it procedure beacuse we have the great planes as well as the water'). SnowLand (scripts/snow/snow_land.gd) reads it and bakes the region map the shaders sample (snow.gdshaderinc snow_land); SnowCover.depth_at() works it out the same way on the CPU (footsteps, prints, the slowed walk).

types: per square type (data/world/squares.json): hold = how much of the snow that falls it keeps (1 the core's depth; the deep woods more, the wind-swept open less), wind = how exposed it is to the wind (0 sheltered woods .. 1 the open plains: scoured bare on the rises and the slopes facing the wind, drifted deep in the lee, rippled across the wind), shed = how readily its slopes shed their snow (1: the cliffs' faces stand bare). Every point is also sheltered by the trees round it (the terrain's forest density).
prevailing_from_deg: the winter wind's true bearing (from the west-north-west over the Mohawk Valley): the drifts and the ripples lie to it.

ice: the water's ice from the month's mean temperature (SurvivalClock low_c and high_c): none above freeze_c, the slow water frozen across below full_c; reach_m of water depth the full ice covers (shelf ice grows out from the banks as it gets colder; the rapids stay open); grow_per_s how fast the shown ice follows (0..1 a second).
